nodes.label: Joint history
nodes.info: The last 0.6 s of proprioception at 50 Hz: 7 joint angles, 7 joint velocities, end-effector pose and twist from forward kinematics, and the previous action.

nodes.label: Current step
nodes.info: The newest observation. The actor sees it directly, next to the latent.

nodes.label: TCN encoder
nodes.info: Three 1-D convolutions (kernel 5, strides 1/2/2) and an MLP (128) compress the history.

nodes.label: Latent z
nodes.info: A 32-value summary of the contact history. The probe in Section 6 reads contact mode from it.

nodes.label: Actor MLP
nodes.info: Gaussian policy on [z, o_t]. PPO trains it with the encoder.

nodes.label: Joint action
nodes.info: A joint-target offset. The joint PD controller holds it for 20 physics steps (20 ms).

nodes.label: Contact decoder
nodes.info: Training only. It predicts free / contact / inside for 64 points on the peg's bottom edge. Its cross-entropy loss shapes z.

nodes.label: Privileged state
nodes.info: Training only. Peg pose and velocity and the 64 × 3 contact labels, plus the actor's observation.

nodes.label: Critic
nodes.info: Training only. Asymmetric value function for PPO.
